## Activity

During April 2021, River Outreach completed 23 captures as part of routine site activity. The recorded activity provides a basis for reviewing throughput, image quality, and the timeliness of subsequent grading. Staff should continue to record capture activity consistently so that operational performance can be monitored and any recurring issues can be addressed through the appropriate support route.

## Image quality

Of the 23 captures, 4 were marked ungradable. This represents an ungradable rate of 17.4 per cent. The result should be reviewed with the site team, with attention to recurring camera issues and any practical steps that may improve image quality. The clinic lead has asked that such issues are logged with the service desk to support follow-up and resolution.

## Grading

Grading identified 1 referable result. The median lag from photograph capture to grading was 0. This indicates that the central grading process maintained prompt turnaround for the activity recorded during April 2021. The site should continue to document operational issues and referable outcomes in the usual manner, ensuring that information remains available for routine review and service improvement.
